description: Tutorial lesson T6 (Krumpin'), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t6_fight fixture -> the Pile In step is now a REAL move (the Boyz' back rank starts outside 2" engagement range, so only 5 of 10 can swing; End Pile In is refused by the tutorial gate, the player opens the Boyz + Warboss row, Auto Pile In / drags the five back-rank models and Confirms — all 10 can now fight) -> Boyz fight the Custodian Guard (pick a melee weapon + target, Weapon to Target, Fight!, Fast Roll, Done) -> the WARBOSS takes his Fights First swing before the enemy gets one (Decline Epic Challenge, assign, Fight!) -> the Custodian Guard swings back and its hit/wound rolls are revealed step by step in the resolution dock (spectating: 'Show Wound Roll' / 'Show Saving Throws', no Command Re-roll on the enemy's dice) before the player rolls their own saves -> end the phase. The attack dialog, the pile-in dialog and the allocation overlay are embedded modal Windows, so their controls are driven via the emit escape hatch. | 19.02/19.03: the Attached unit fights as ONE — a single 'Boyz + Warboss' row, one Epic Challenge offer, one attack dialog carrying the mob's choppas AND the leader's Power klaw, and one activation stamping has_fought on both, so the Warboss no longer takes a second swing with the enemy activating in between; and the Custodes' swing back can no longer single him out — the wounds group onto his Boyz first.

steps.script: TutorialManager.active
TutorialManager.current_step_id()

steps.comment: no model base anywhere on the board may overlap another (the Custodian Guard used to sit on a 60px pitch, 3px inside each other's 40mm bases)
5 front-rank Boyz + the Warboss are in real base-to-base contact with the Custodian Guard line

THE PREMISE OF THE STEP: only the five front-rank Boyz are within 2" of the Custodes. The back rank starts 2.3-2.8" off and cannot swing at all until the player pile-ins them in — the fixture used to park them in base contact with the front rank, so the whole mob was already fighting and the Pile In step had nothing to teach.

the step no longer allows END_PILE_IN — skipping the pile-in would leave half the mob unable to swing, so the tutorial gate refuses it and toasts the blocked_hint

steps.comment: THE REPORTED BUG: the Warboss took a SECOND activation of his own after his Boyz had swung, and the Custodes got to fight in between. 19.03 — the Attached unit fights as ONE unit: that single activation stamps has_fought on BOTH components, Player 1 has nothing left owed a fight, and the FIGHT SEQUENCE panel lists one combatant, not two.

steps.comment: THE OTHER HALF OF THE REPORTED BUG: the Warboss leads the Boyz, but he was offered as a melee target in his own right — and because the wound-allocation fold is built from the TARGET unit, picking him produced a single 'CHARACTER — 1 model' allocation group, so all 15 Guardian spear wounds landed on the Boss while the 10 Boyz stood untouched. 19.02: the Attached unit is ONE unit, so the leader is hidden behind his bodyguard in the UI list, in the engine list AND in the AI's fight plan.

the AI now takes its alternating activation (select the Custodian Guard, assign, roll to hit) and then PARKS at the staged hit pause — nothing may press for it, or the reveal the player is meant to watch is gone

THE REPORTED BUG: the enemy's swing back used to resolve hits AND wounds in one shot and hand the player a finished 'N wounds to save' prompt. It now rolls out in the dock the player's own attacks use — spectating, 'Show Wound Roll' rather than 'Roll to Wound' (they are not the player's dice to roll), and no Command Re-roll offered on them.
show the enemy's wound roll
the wound roll is its own step too — the player sees how many wounds are coming before rolling a single save
hand the batch to the player's own save overlay
and the player still rolls their own saves, with the save Command Re-roll available there

the save card the player is handed is for the ATTACHED unit: 2 bodyguard groups (Boss Nob W2 + Boyz W1) and the Warboss as ONE character group, with a bodyguard group first in the allocation order (05.04 — no CHARACTER group before a non-CHARACTER one). Before the fix this card read 'Allocate Attacks — Warboss' with a single 'CHARACTER — 1 model(s)' row.
Confirm Order & Roll Saves
Keep Rolls / Auto-pick casualties
Done
the enemy really did swing back — and it still had models to do it with (10 Boyz swinging the Boss Nob's Power klaw used to wipe the squad 38% of the time)

THE LEADER RULE, stated as an invariant so it holds whatever the dice do: the attached Warboss may only have lost wounds once every Boy is dead. The reported bug wiped the Boss outright (6 W gone to 15 Guardian spear wounds) with all 10 Boyz still standing.
